must.title: Security and Compliance
must.description: Ensure the system is secure and complies with relevant regulations.
must.metric: Zero critical vulnerabilities in SAST scans.
acceptance_criteria: Security scans show no critical vulnerabilities.
Data encryption is applied to sensitive data.

must.title: Reliability
must.description: Ensure the system is reliable and available.
must.metric: System uptime > 99.9% over a rolling 30-day window.
acceptance_criteria: Incident response times meet defined SLAs.
Redundancy is built into critical components.

should.title: Performance Optimization
should.description: Ensure the system performs efficiently under expected load conditions.
should.metric: System response time < 2 seconds for 95% of requests.
acceptance_criteria: Load testing shows response times within target.
Bottlenecks are identified and resolved promptly.
should.verification: Load test at 10× expected peak; measure p95/p99.

should.title: Scalability
should.description: The system should scale to accommodate increased user load.
should.metric: System scales to 2× current user base without degradation.
acceptance_criteria: Scalability tests confirm system can handle increased load.
Database performance remains stable under load.
Application servers auto-scale based on demand.
should.verification: Scalability test with simulated load increase.

should.title: Usability
should.description: Ensure the system is user-friendly and easy to navigate.
should.metric: User satisfaction score > 85% in usability tests.
acceptance_criteria: Usability tests show high user satisfaction.
User feedback is incorporated into design improvements.
should.verification: Usability testing with target user groups.

executive_summary: This project aims to modernize the MagicBox platform by migrating from PHP to .NET 8 and React, ensuring legacy functionality is preserved while enhancing performance and security.
